title: AFCI-Bench v2 Dependency-Direction Conformance Oracle Result
description: Dependency-direction conformance measurement for one run, assembled from the raw, blind architecture_finding.json. AUTHORITATIVE FOR E1: the opportunity_accounting object is REQUIRED and is the only admissible source of the primary endpoint - E1 is the dependency-direction violation rate per applicable frozen opportunity, numerator opportunity_accounting.violated_opportunity_count over offset opportunity_accounting.applicable_opportunity_count (frozen per task manifest, NOT derived from touched files). applicable_rule_count, rules_satisfied_count and satisfaction_proportion are LEGACY DESCRIPTIVE DIAGNOSTICS ONLY: applicable_rule_count is NOT an admissible E1 denominator or offset, and rule satisfaction is NOT a direct architectural-conformance measurement and is never E1 or E2. A result carrying only rule-based accounting is NOT sufficient for E1. Stub/unimplemented rules report UNIMPLEMENTED, never PASS, and contribute nothing to either side of the rate; manual adjudication is CON-ACB secondary evidence and is never pooled in. raw_violation_count is a separate descriptive series. condition/model are appended only after blind scoring. Development scaffolding for study v2; no paid run produced it. Conformance here is dependency direction only - NOT broad architectural conformance, NOT churn/Delta-CodeLOC, NOT visible-CI pass.

opportunity_accounting.description: AUTHORITATIVE E1 ACCOUNTING (mirrors architecture_finding.schema.json). E1 numerator = violated_opportunity_count; E1 denominator/offset = applicable_opportunity_count, frozen per task manifest and NOT derived from how many files or layers the change touched. Only implemented dependency-direction opportunities (AR-DEP-001..006) enter these counts: stub/unimplemented rules and manual adjudication contribute nothing. applicable_opportunity_count = 0 means the task is STRUCTURALLY INELIGIBLE for E1 - it is excluded from the E1 model as out-of-exposure and must NOT be entered as zero violations, a zero numerator, or a failed run.

e1_analysis_eligibility.description: Analysis eligibility carried through from the frozen evaluator manifest, which must itself match the approved public task index. 'scored' may enter E1 (and requires a non-zero applicable_opportunity_count); 'functional-only' is structurally excluded from E1 but still contributes to E3, cost and exploratory analyses; 'inactive-reserve' enters no endpoint unless a separately recorded pre-run activation decision changes it.

applicable_rule_count.description: LEGACY DESCRIPTIVE DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Count of rules put in force for the task. This is NOT an admissible E1 denominator or offset (STATISTICAL_ANALYSIS_PLAN.md 2.1): it counts rules registered, not exposure. Never use it to compute a rate.

violation_count.description: Descriptive. Violations attributed to evaluated rules. The E1 numerator is opportunity_accounting.violated_opportunity_count, not this field.

rules_satisfied_count.description: LEGACY DESCRIPTIVE DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Not an endpoint input.

satisfaction_proportion.description: LEGACY DESCRIPTIVE DIAGNOSTIC ONLY - the per-rule satisfaction proportion. It is NOT a direct architectural-conformance measurement and is never E1 or E2. The descriptive transformation of E1 (E2) is the applicable-FROZEN-OPPORTUNITY satisfaction proportion, derived from opportunity_accounting.

verdict.description: CONFORMANT/VIOLATIONS/PENDING are assembled from a scored architecture_finding.json. FAIL_CLOSED carries the raw finding's fail-closed verdict faithfully (kept distinct from PENDING, which means awaiting manual rating); a run that fails closed by the engine throwing instead records an INFRA_* exit_reason on the run manifest and produces no scored result.

raw_violation_count.description: Required. Count of all forbidden edges detected in the whole snapshot, including edges that link to no frozen opportunity. A SEPARATE descriptive diagnostic series: reported alongside E1 and never substituted into it. raw_violation_count > violated_opportunity_count is EXPECTED and not by itself a defect signal: opportunities are attributed by frozen architectural SCOPE, so several forbidden edges inside one frozen decision collapse to one violated opportunity, and a forbidden edge outside every frozen decision counts here only (TD-B27).

finding_artifact_ref.description: Optional. Path to the raw architecture_finding.json this result was assembled from.

blind_scored.description: Optional. True when the finding was produced without condition/model in scope (condition/model appended afterward).
